_comment: Editable rules. A mod matches a member when its name, file name or tags match any pattern (case-insensitive regular expressions). If more than max_enabled members of one rule are enabled, fcmh reports the rule. Copy this file and pass --rules to use your own version.

rules.description: These mods all rewrite youth academy / regen generation. Pick ONE academy direction.
rules.advice: Keep one academy mod enabled. If you keep KIARIKA Career Mode Overhaul together with an academy mod, disable KIARIKA's youth/regen section first (see its mod page).

rules.description: Two gameplay overhauls edit the same gameplay values and must not run together.
rules.advice: Keep only one gameplay overhaul enabled.
